sloka: विश्वासार्थं तु वैदेहि भर्तुरुक्ता मया गुणाः ।अचिराद् राघवो देवि त्वामितो नयिता ऽनघे ।। ५.३५.८३।।।।
transliteration: viśvāsārthaṁ tu vaidehi bharturuktā mayā guṇāḥ ।acirād rāghavo devi tvāmito nayitā 'naghe ।। 5.35.83।।।।

translations.english: "In order to inspire confidence in you about me I have narrated the virtues of your husband. O sinless queen Rama will take you from here very soon".
